title: Moving three WooCommerce stores with 15,000+ SKUs from cPanel to AWS
excerpt: A hosting migration and programmatic SEO program for an electronic parts distributor, with a 25% lift in clicks and impressions within two months.
content:
The problem

Three WooCommerce catalogues with more than 15,000 products had outgrown shared cPanel hosting. Pages were slow, indexing was patchy and every traffic spike was a risk.

The approach

  • Designed AWS VPCs for internal and external applications, then migrated all three stores off cPanel
  • Hardened networking and kept servers highly available
  • Rolled out programmatic SEO templates to improve indexing across the catalogue
  • Iterated on conversion paths using performance data

The result

Faster, more resilient storefronts, and a 25% increase in clicks and impressions within two months.
